Name: CP - Shadow Recipes
Author: DuchessIvy
Description:
This mod was inspired by a desire to expand on the available lore for the Shadow People/Void Spirits, and to further humanize them. These recipes are cultural delicacies, some of which have become staples in human cuisine.

[b]Recipes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Black Cherry Flan ﻿[spoiler] Blackberry, Cherry, Void Egg, Milk, Sugar [/spoiler]
[*]Void Cake ﻿[spoiler] Void Egg, Sugar, Wheat Flour [/spoiler]
[*]Spooky Sushi ﻿[spoiler] Spook Fish, Rice, Seaweed, Wild Horseradish, Ginger [/spoiler]
[*]Pumpkin Bread ﻿[spoiler] Pumpkin, Wheat Flour, Oil, Egg, Sugar [/spoiler]
[*]Pumpkin Latte ﻿[spoiler] Coffee, Sugar, Milk, Pumpkin, Ginger [/spoiler]
[*]Savory Squid Stew ﻿[spoiler] Midnight Squid, Summer Squash, Hot Pepper, Garlic [/spoiler]
[*]Braised Midnight Carp ﻿[spoiler] Midnight Carp, Magma Cap Mushroom, Garlic, Hot Pepper [/spoiler]
[*]Void Caviar Toast ﻿[spoiler] Roe, Void Mayonnaise, Bread, Spring Onion [/spoiler]
[*]Crystal Float ﻿[spoiler] Crystal Fruit, Joja Cola, Milk, Sugar [/spoiler]
[/list]
I've added some basic gift tastes for Krobus, Abigail, and Sebastian. I'm happy to expand those based on suggestions, and if you have an NPC you've created that you'd like to be added, please let me know!

This mod has compatibility with Lurking in the Dark/Diamond in the Rough! Thank you 7thAxis! In order to get compatibility, you'll need to do so by downloading the most recent version of [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Lurking in the Dark[/url] or Diamond in the Rough once that mod is completed. Sen has gift tastes and custom dialogue with those mods!

All but 1 of the recipes can be purchased from Gus, Sandy, or Krobus. The Savory Squid Stew will be sent to you after you've gotten to know Krobus a little better.

This is my very first mod, so I expect there to be potential issues. If you want to translate the mod, I may need to add additional code (which I am happy to do!).

[b]Required Mods:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=files]SMAPI version 4.0.0 or higher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher 2.0.0 or higher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536?tab=description]Mail Framework Mod 1.17.0 or higher[/url]﻿
[/list]
Hopefully, I'll be able to create more mods in the future. I have an idea for a "Comfort Foods" style recipe pack, and I have big dreams to make a whole Shadow People expansion, but that's far in the future.

Thank you to the incredible people in the Sunberry Village discord server and the Stardew Modmaker Community! Y'all truly made this possible.

Downloads.Description: 9 new recipes using vanilla SDV ingredients. Fixed Spooky Sushi missing seaweed, added gift tastes for Jas, Vincent, Willy.
